_note: Resource type -> the ItemIcons sprite the GAME names for it. Read off the live client's own config (DataCenter.ResourceTemplateManager.resourceTemplateDic): every template carries `icon` (an atlas name) and `big_icon` (a path under Assets/Main/Sprites/ItemIcons/). The stem of `big_icon` is what tools/extract_item_icons.py writes into results/item_icons/item, so it is what /api/itemicon can serve. Types whose only picture is a Common_icon_* atlas entry are absent on purpose: that atlas is not extracted, and a resource with no sprite draws its name rather than borrowing another resource's art.
